stages.label: Intake and ownership
stages.instructions: Validate the webhook context, repository, scope, permissions, and acceptance criteria. Confirm that the issue is actually In Progress.

stages.label: Reproduce the issue
stages.instructions: Reproduce the defect before changing production code. Prefer a deterministic failing automated test and capture environment details.

stages.label: Plan with single-agent or three-agent mixture of agents
stages.instructions: For simple work, produce one plan. For ambiguous or high-risk work, ask three strong planning peers independently, compare assumptions and tradeoffs, record contradictions, and synthesize the best evidence-backed plan.

stages.label: Review the plan
stages.instructions: Have an independent reviewer challenge correctness, security, migration, test, and rollback assumptions. Revise the plan when findings are material.

stages.label: Implementation
stages.instructions: Implement the reviewed plan with explicit file ownership. Keep changes focused and preserve unrelated user work.

stages.label: Local code checks
stages.instructions: Run the repository-defined lint, build/typecheck, security scan, and Playwright suite. A warning or failure must be recorded, corrected, and rerun; do not downgrade a gate silently.

stages.label: Repository and CodeRabbit gates
stages.instructions: Reproduce required repository checks locally where possible. Address CodeRabbit or equivalent review findings by evidence and rerun affected gates.

stages.label: Documentation
stages.instructions: Update user, operator, architecture, changelog, and test-matrix material affected by the change.

stages.label: Push, open review, and watch
stages.instructions: When authorized, push the branch and open or update the review. Watch CI and review checks. Record every warning or failure, fix it, push again, and continue watching until required checks pass.

stages.label: Merge
stages.instructions: Merge only when approvals, required checks, branch policy, and user authorization permit it. Capture the resulting merge commit.

stages.label: Update Jira
stages.instructions: Update the Jira issue through an authorized integration with the outcome, implementation and test evidence, pull request, merge commit, and any follow-up risk. Transition it according to team policy.
requiredEvidence: links to pull request and merge

stages.label: Continuous-improvement retrospective
stages.instructions: Review the run journal. Turn recurring errors, contradictions, delays, flaky gates, and harness friction into an evidence-linked improvement backlog. Do not apply policy changes automatically.
